title: Every control in Tech View and Board View works from the keyboard
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 px wide, so the display switcher (List, Tech View, Board View) shows at the right of the Work Orders toolbar.
  • Technician {Technician-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.
  • Technician {Technician-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Controls") has four Approved work orders: {Work-order-1} (for example S10043-17701) and {Work-order-2} (for example S10043-17702) led by {Technician-A}, {Work-order-3} (for example S10043-17703) led by {Technician-B}, and {Work-order-4} (for example S10043-17704) with no lead technician.
  • {Technician-A} is not pinned for you at the start.
  • Tech View shows the Assigned Techs column (it is on by default).
  • No technician has a shift on the Schedule for these work orders.
  • On the Work Orders page nothing is ticked in Status, Asset on Site shows no choice (if its chip shows Yes or No, click the x on the chip), Assigned to me is off and Search is empty.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  2. Type the name of {Customer-A} in Search.
  3. Click Board View in the display switcher.
  4. Click once in the Search box, then put the mouse aside: from here on use only the keyboard, except where a step says to click.
  5. Press Tab until {Work-order-1}'s card has focus, and look at the card.
  6. Press Tab until the card's More actions (…) button has focus, and press Enter.
  7. Press Escape.
  8. Press Space.
  9. Press Escape.
  10. Press Tab until the pin button in {Technician-A}'s column header has focus, and press Enter.
  11. Press Space.
  12. Click Tech View in the display switcher, click once in the Search box and put the mouse aside again.
  13. Press Tab until the arrow in {Technician-A}'s group header has focus, and press Enter.
  14. Press Space.
  15. Press Tab until an avatar in {Work-order-1}'s Assigned Techs cell has focus.
  16. Press Shift+Tab until the Column Selection button has focus, press Enter, press Tab once, then press Escape.
  17. Click Status, tick Approved and press Escape, then press Tab until the x on the Status filter has focus and press Enter.
  18. Press Shift+Tab until the Board View button of the display switcher has focus, and press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: the focused card shows a focus ring and its More actions (…) button appears without hovering.
  • Step 6: Enter opens the card's menu.
  • Step 7: Escape closes the menu without changing anything, and focus is back on the More actions (…) button.
  • Steps 8 and 9: Space opens the menu as well, and Escape closes it again.
  • Step 10: Enter pins {Technician-A}: the pin button shows the pinned state.
  • Step 11: Space unpins {Technician-A}.
  • Step 13: Enter collapses {Technician-A}'s group.
  • Step 14: Space expands it again.
  • Step 15: the technician's name shows for the focused avatar, the same as on hover.
  • Step 16: Enter opens the Column Selection options, Tab moves inside them, and Escape closes them with focus back on the Column Selection button.
  • Step 17: Enter on the x clears the Status filter.
  • Step 18: Enter switches to Board View.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10054 (Story 11, Keyboard access and focus); SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 54 (15 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S11-R2, S11-R5, S11-R6, S11-R7, S11-R8 and S3-R13, read 15 Oct 2026. Tech plan (revised 24 Sep 2026) Phase 11. Product owner answers: Chris Ward, WO Board and Tech View question sheet (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1gBGmNB4B1bRrD2ZJvBn1tuvbfxFPjcsKddz_I5H3CvU), answer 28, read 15 Oct 2026. Source-verified 15 October 2026. Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026, before the expected results changed on 15 Oct 2026; the changed results have not yet been checked against a build.

Until 15 Oct 2026 Story 11 only listed keyboard behaviour the design still had to define, so this case asked the tester to try keys and write down what each did. Chris Ward answered on 15 Oct 2026 (answer 28): Tab reaches every control, Enter opens, Escape closes, focus returns to the control that opened a menu or dialog, reassigning by keyboard goes through the ⋯ menu, and there is no keyboard drag. PRD version 54 rewrites Story 11 into these requirements, and this case now checks them.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R2: “Every control a mouse can use in Tech View and Board View is reachable with Tab and works with Enter or Space, as the design system’s menus and dialogs do: the more-actions button (which appears on keyboard focus, S3-R13), the Columns options, the x on a filter chip, and the display switcher. Technician names behind avatars show on keyboard focus, the same as on hover.”
  • S11-R5: “Escape closes an open menu, dialog or tooltip without changing anything.”
  • S11-R6: “When a menu or dialog closes, focus returns to the control that opened it.”
  • S11-R7: “Pin and unpin buttons are reachable with Tab and toggle with Enter or Space.”
  • S11-R8: “The collapse chevron on each group header is reachable with Tab and toggles with Enter or Space.”
  • S3-R13: “Reveal the card’s more-actions overlay on hover or keyboard focus.”
  • Tech plan Phase 11 controls: “Every control is a real button with an `aria-label`; the more-actions overlay reveals on `:focus-within`; pin and collapse are keyboard-reachable (S11-R2, S11-R7, S11-R8)”
